__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This small dragon hisses at you as you enter the room.  Although it is only a
few feet long, its sharp teeth make you think twice about petting it.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A dragon hatchling is here, chewing on a bone.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle hatchling dragon baby

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This horrible creature is a bizarre cross between a man and a dragon.  He
has black scales and a seven foot wingspan.  He scowls at you and hefts his
spear as you enter the room.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle draconian

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He doesn't look happy to see you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The lord of this crypt is here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle lord crypt master

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
A powerful looking mage is standing in this room studying his spells.  You are
surprised at the fact that he is human, and realize that he must be very
powerful to have been accepted by the creatures which live here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A man is here, studying some books.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle man mage wizard

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
A Draconian stands here, dressed in simple robes.  Around his neck you
notice a golden medallion in the shape of a five headed dragon.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A Draconian is here, deep in thought.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle cleric draconian

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The king of the draconians sits here on a golden throne.  He looks as
though he could crush your head with a single blow.  Yet you sense that he
is controlled by a greater power.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A Draconian wearing fine clothes is here, pondering his greatness.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle king draconian

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This is a concubine of the king.  She is lounging here, wearing nothing at
all.  You find yourself strangely repulsed as she draws a knife and
prepares to defend herself.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle concubine draconian

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This creature has devoted its life to defending the king.  Your intrusion has
not pleased it.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A bodyguard is here, staring at you menacingly.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle bodyguard draconian

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
You see before you the master of this Tower, Tiamat.  She frowns at you as she
prepares to make you pay for your insolence ... with your lives!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A five headed dragon hisses at you as you enter this room.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle tiamat dragon

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This huge red dragon dominates the chamber.  As you turn to flee, he grins at
you and invites you to stay ... forever!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A red dragon is here, contemplating your existence.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle dragon red

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This huge black wyrm laughs at your puny weapons.  You realize that he is not
going to roll over and die for you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A black dragon is here, laughing at your insolence.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle dragon black

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This dragon towers over you.  Recalling your previous experiences with white
dragons, you are not afraid.  She smiles at you and says 'I think you will find
me a greater challenge than my offspring.'
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A white dragon is here, waiting for you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle dragon white

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This huge beast appears to be the most directly related to the draconians.
She looks at you with sorrow in her eyes and says 'You have slaughtered my
children.  Prepare to die.'
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A green dragon is here, looking distraught.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle dragon green

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
A hydra is here, guarding the entrance to a sealed vault.  You have the feeling
it isn't happy to see you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A hydra is here, blocking the doorway.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle hydra

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
He looks like he's under a lot of stress.  He would probably like it if you
left him alone.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A Human slave is here, hard at work.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle slave human

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This used to be one of the warriors of this tribe.  He was denied his final
rest, however, and now guards this corridor tirelessly as a zombie.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A Draconian zombie is here, staring at nothing in particular.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle zombie draconian

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: This small dragon looks like he's up to no good.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A Phase Dragon is darting around the room.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle dragon phase

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This dragon man looks VERY foolish, dressed in a green and blue striped
suit.  As you enter the room, he points at you and laughs.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A Fool is here, making fun of you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle fool draconian

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This draconian looks VERY busy as she orders her slaves around.  You think
it might be a good idea to leave her alone.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A Female Draconian sits, here, looking very important.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle queen draconian
